subject: glessner_frances_m_1904

shot.build: stage, tree d4fae0e81 + 5 uncommitted figure file(s)

silhouette.what: Silhouette and fit of the clothes
silhouette.note: The skirt is a dome from the hips to a hem wider than the shoulders are tall, which reads as a crinoline at 3 m and as an over-wide bell at 10 m; the 1902 Met skirt and the Easter 1904 women are close over the hips and flare from about the knee. Jacket to the hip with a short peplum reads as the Met coat cut shorter.

folds.note: The skirt is a smooth shell with no gores or folds; the Met skirt shows gore seams and the Easter skirts break in folds at the hem as the women walk.

hat_hair.note: A broad dark hat trimmed high with grey plumes over drawn-up hair: the Easter crowd and Mrs. Fairbanks wear the same kind, hers paler and heaped higher.

skin.note: Monochrome prints. Face and hands read at 3 m; the hands are warmer (orange) in the stage light than the face.

hands.note: Clasped in front at the waist; the crossed fingers are bulky at 3 m. The pictures show gloved or bare hands at the sides or raised.

stance.what: How the figure stands or sits
stance.note: Upright, feet hidden under the skirt, as the matrons stand.

motion.note: Mid-stride the skirt swings as one shell and the legs never show; the Easter women walk with the hem breaking forward. The strip is shot on the stage, following her.

differences.picture: Gored skirt close at waist and hips, flaring from about the knee (Met 1902 suit); Easter 1904 skirts nearly columnar to the ground.
differences.ours: Bell from the hips, widest at the hem and far wider there than the pictures' skirts; reads as a crinoline.

differences.picture: Gore seams and braid at the hem (Met); folds at the hem when walking (Easter).
differences.ours: Smooth untextured shell, no seams, no braid, no folds.

differences.picture: Tall cream lace standing collar and a lace jabot falling from it (Fairbanks; Met bodice yoke).
differences.ours: A plain pale grey stand collar and a grey V-front; no lace, no jabot; reads grey, not cream or white.

differences.picture: Lace frills at the wrists (Fairbanks); braided cuffs on the Met coat.
differences.ours: Plain black sleeves to the wrist; no frill, no braid.

differences.picture: Met coat to the upper thigh, lapels, buttoned below the bust, braid at cuffs and hem; Fairbanks coat open over a pale front.
differences.ours: Black jacket to the hip with a peplum, closed, no braid; pale front shows only as a narrow V.

differences.picture: Black wool suit (Met, in colour); dark coats in the monochrome prints.
Broad hat heaped with pale plumes (Fairbanks), broad hats trimmed high (Easter).
differences.ours: Broad black hat, grey plumes; less heaped, darker plumes.
